text:
alice: Heads-up deploy-bot paused rollout for svc/order-api in eu-west due to label selector collision after values merge. It flagged two ReplicaSets matching same selector :confused:

deploy-bot: [automated] Rollout paused for release 'order-api' (ns=payments) - selector conflict detected. See /deploy/logs/1749998765

ben: Oof. Which values changed? selector in chart or values.yaml?

dana: Looks like values change set app.selector to "order-api" but chart template expects "app.kubernetes.io/name: order-api". Two selectors now match older rs.

eric: Can we pin to previous chart version while we fix values? I can cut a hotpatch to restore old selector.

alice: Thinking: options — 1) patch the new release to use unique selector via helm upgrade --reuse-values --set ingress.selector=order-api-v2 2) rollback to chart@1.4.2 3) manual patch RS to detach (kubectl patch rs ...) 4) schedule a short change window and coordinate DB-safe restart.

ben: I prefer rollback to avoid partial traffic on mixed selectors. How disruptive is rollback? Any migrations?

dana: No schema migrations. It's purely selector/name change. Rollback should be safe if we pin image/tag and chart version.

eric: I'll prepare a rollback playbook. Command: helm rollback order-api 3 --namespace payments

alice: Also need release notes update and a short blurb for infra-alerts channel. If we rollback, update CHANGELOG: revert selector change and note follow-up PR to normalize templates.

deploy-bot: [automated] Can deploy-bot perform rollback? Manual confirmation required. React with :thumbsup: to confirm.

alice: :thumbsup: I'm giving manual OK to rollback now.

ben: :thumbsup: rolling back

ci-bot: Running helm rollback job (job id 7462)...

ci-bot: helm rollback succeeded. New release revision=4

dana: Confirming pods stable. kubectl get rs -n payments | grep order-api -> looks good. No duplicate selectors now.

eric: I'll follow up with a small PR to unify selector templates and add test in chart CI to catch selector collisions.

alice: Thanks all. I'll add release-note entry and scheduled follow-up during next change window (tomorrow 03:00 UTC) to apply normalized values.

ben: ping me if you want me on the follow-up run.

alice: noted, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
